versions.changelog: Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Adds initial skill for generating a four-to-eight still KYC guide pack from a user-supplied account-opening materials checklist.
- Guides users in submitting exact material names and approved lines, ensuring no missing or invented requirements.
- Produces a labeled pack list for free before any paid graphic creation, maintaining consistent style across the set.
- Outlines distinct workflow: one still per named material, single approval and billing per image, and reliable recovery instructions.
- Enforces use of the bundled MCP client for all Beatra service operations, disallowing external connectors or REST as fallback.
- Implements automatic, safe package updates with fail-open behavior for uninterrupted use.
